OBJECTIVE

Advance StoryAtlas from the current War-of-the-Ghosts proof into a provider-integrated, evidence-preserving research and publication instrument without moving scientific inference into the application or narrative semantics into Intaglio.

CURRENT BASELINES — verified 2026-08-31

- StoryAtlas main is 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5. It pins storymodel4s 3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af and Intaglio 596b398af380079e4b251535230d0bc03cd88c51.
- StoryAtlas docs candidate cand-1H40V88SM87KE3P2HBQ8C54JA1 at 234f0c410428e8ba1acd0f0cdacee29d489485ed is independently approved and awaits authorization.
- Mockup candidate cand-1NFG8CC1R6Z4H1SJTCC2VYFPRF at 34caf555d0b4137d3327c6d8db8783f631d1b653 preserves substantial DPR2 repairs but is blocked by the implementation, science, and UX reviewers. Its successor must retain every passing repair and close I1-I4, S1-S3, and U1.
- storymodel4s main is e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. The exact output-bundle specification at SHA-256 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f received independent off-tree acceptance, but no durable provider API candidate, public vocabulary authorization, dependency ruling, or landed implementation exists. Foreign epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ is provenance only.
- Intaglio main and origin/main are 1742ce212b06e0a13c1605f4e6ed353a014ae43a. Commits 0fc7baa and 1742ce2 closed native Mote intaglio-compatibility with a compatibility baseline, MiMa/version-policy and TASTy-MiMa courts, preserved intentional aliases, and a clean local worktree. Hosted CI has not been inspected. Native open Motes remain intaglio-ci-matrix, intaglio-architecture-docs, intaglio-user-docs, and intaglio-release-infra.

OWNERSHIP AND COORDINATION

- storymodel4s owns scientific meaning, canonical interchange, addresses, projection contracts, feature derivations, alignment, typed outcomes, and evidence.
- StoryAtlas owns pagination, device geometry, lowering, interaction, accessibility, static reports, textual twins, figures, manifests it is authorized to assemble, and layout/export receipts.
- Intaglio is a generic renderer backend, not a narrative ontology. StoryAtlas-specific marks or meanings must not enter it.
- Mote stores are independent. Foreign issue and post IDs are provenance, never cross-store dependency edges. Local mirror/adoption beads carry the StoryAtlas side of an external gate.

DELIVERY LANES

1. Proceed now on StoryAtlas-owned work: recut the mockup successor; certify the static preview profile over existing view artifacts; run the cross-page relation comparison; harden browser, accessibility, identity, and publication courts; and evaluate the new Intaglio compatibility baseline as a consumer.
2. In parallel, obtain durable provider contracts: first the story-output bundle and exact text/outcome vocabulary, then real feature, chronology, recall/privacy, and interview packets.
3. Integrate only exact reviewed provider candidates by immutable ProjectRef pins and full consumer gates. Do not bind off-tree draft names or create a parallel semantic authority in StoryAtlas.
4. Advance by vertical slices: one real feature, provider-compiled chronology, known-source recall, autobiographical interview, a second structurally distinct story, then novel-scale, multi-recall, and population gates.

NON-NEGOTIABLE PRODUCT LAWS

- Canonical preview.html is self-contained static HTML/CSS with inline SVG as document content, no JavaScript or inline handlers, no external resources or sibling-role fetch dependence, and direct filesystem opening. The richer interactive application is a separate target.
- Exact text remains DOM text. Scientific identity is typed Address; renderer identities remain distinct.
- Geometry may change, but identity, evidence descent, requested-layer disposition, missingness, alternatives, external or abstained mass, and truthful OnMark/ViaAncestor/OffProjection placement may not be silently lost.
- No feature smoothing, chronology, absence, alignment, privacy permission, or authority label is inferred in the view.
- Accessibility and non-colour semantics are local executable laws, not legend promises.
- Renderer expansion is benchmark-triggered. The existing shared-pattern diagnostic motivates evaluation of a generic compact paint/pattern mechanism but authorizes no upstream API by itself.
- Local green checks do not prove hosted CI, publication, or live remote state.

EPIC ACCEPTANCE

- Every contained bead is closed with exact-source evidence and honest provider/runtime boundaries.
- Static publication and the interactive workspace share semantic identities but have separately tested contracts.
- Final provider integrations are pinned to reviewed, reachable commits and pass compileAll, testAll, scalafmtCheckAll, app/fastLinkJS, relevant browser courts, textual-twin and mutation courts.
- A second substantial narrative passes before any story-independent claim.
- Novel-scale, multi-recall, and population claims require named latency, memory, mark-budget, evidence, privacy, accessibility, and usability gates.
- No landing, push, release, provider API, or Intaglio upstream change is inferred from creation of this epic.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force. The dated August baseline/lane ordering above is historical; current execution follows the preserved M1 chain, then source comprehension, whole-inventory navigation and film/media. Four-screen completion is bd-01M35A7FFN4JYRRDYXS36KTGW2; it does not close broader feature/cohort/temporal/chronology/interview commitments. No new frontend or view-side inference. The prior raster mockup task/candidate and its custody obligations are not closed by the new design.
Bounded child work (reuse these tickets rather than reimplementing inside this parent):
- bd-01M35A7C3DNH8TCNEADM5HAKQJ — [Story] Qualify supplied hierarchy, contexts and relation capabilities
- bd-01M35A7C9MYCHFJD0XMVT7JRYW — [Story] Add supplied narrative score and scene-to-event drilldown
- bd-01M35A7CGKXVT75KY91D3KATA9 — [Story] Index permitted source and recall text for exact search
- bd-01M35A7CQVFV9PYPABKXH3624W — [Story] Inspect bounded typed relationships and the complete relation list
- bd-01M35A7CYNA8C2B3DV534449E3 — [Story] Qualify source-only reading and recall attachment on unfamiliar text
- bd-01M35A7DSD742GF29E3S3292H9 — [Film] Adopt exact compiled-film, occurrence and media capabilities
- bd-01M35A7E24BZ6KPTB0B31FGSDB — [Film] Mount independent source-video and recall-audio controls
- bd-01M35A7E8A0VMS0GR1RAB9NBER — [Film] Link scene exploration to retained recall context and evidence
- bd-01M35A7EEC15KAFN2K1M5EFCAH — [Film] Qualify whole-movie recall and scene exploration end to end
- bd-01M35A7ENQC6441TVS9J6NSC4K — [UX] Run early scientist comprehension tasks on the joined text workspace
- bd-01M35A7EWX4BB7WMSY558THJ4K — [UX] Qualify the four configurations across layout, keyboard and contrast
- bd-01M35A7F38MAF40D5NRV4F0CTG — [UX] Validate final scientist comprehension after repairs
- bd-01M35A7F9AFXF2BN6J2PDK3VJQ — [Release] Document local opening, missing capabilities and reproducible exports
- bd-01M35A7FFN4JYRRDYXS36KTGW2 — [Workspace] Accept the complete four-mockup research workspace
